\section{The polynomial \texorpdfstring{$P_1$}{P1}}\label{app:polynomial}

The following table gives every coefficient of
\[
 P_1(X)=\sum_{i=0}^{65}a_iX^i\in\Z[X].
\]
This monic irreducible polynomial defines the $s=1$ specialization field
of \cref{cor:smaller}. Its Galois group over $\Q$ is $\Sz(8)$, its signature
is $(1,32)$, and its largest coefficient has $43$ decimal digits.
The exact field isomorphism and the two Frobenius witnesses are described
in \cref{sec:s1}.
